args.evidence: raw.orders contains 15000 rows, but stg_orders only 14941 rows (59 rows missing). The stg_orders model applies a filter: o_orderdate < max(o_orderdate) - interval 7 day, which excludes the most recent 7 days of orders. This causes the freshness check to fail (1 stale row) and creates 230 orphaned lineitem rows (FK relationship failure). The problem originates from the filter logic in the stg_orders model, a code change, and can be fixed by adjusting or removing the date filter.
